nodes.label: Danger Warning Animation
nodes.description: Animated GIF depicting a warning/danger icon: a rounded triangle with a dark navy blue outer border, a thick orange/amber inner border, a white fill, and an orange exclamation mark (! symbol) in the center. A light blue reflective sheen is visible on the lower-left of the triangle interior. Used as a visual alert or danger indicator in the UI, likely shown in warning dialogs, error states, or cautionary modals.
